title: Conditions to check for Downgrading Your Plan

question.author: member_033
question.body: Could support clarify downgrading your plan in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: To keep everything, either free up space or upgrade again within the 90-day window. When you downgrade to a plan with less storage, CloudBox never deletes your data immediately. Files above the new quota become read-only/download-only for 90 days, and new uploads are blocked. Shared links to over-quota content remain live during those 90 days but only allow viewing and downloading — no uploads through links. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
